# serverguard24_contact (Resource)

Manages a Serverguard24 contact.

~> **API limitation:** The API only exposes a subset of the fields visible in the Serverguard24 UI. The following settings must be configured manually in the UI and cannot be managed via Terraform: email format, SMS/phone notification time windows (*Zeitraum*), interval between phone calls (*Abstand zwischen 2 Anrufen*), and phone country code prefix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "serverguard24_contact" "ops" {
  name     = "Ops Team"
  language = "en"
  email    = "ops@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `language` (String) Notification language: `en` or `de`.
- `name` (String) Display name for the contact.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address for alert notifications.
- `mobile` (String) Mobile phone number for SMS alerts.
- `network` (String) Network push address.
- `standard` (Boolean) Whether this is the default contact.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
